video.title: Dr Banana | Det Gode Selskab x Burn Energy Tour x Mixmag | Norway
video.description:
Dr Banana brings a deep selection of house and garage for a DJ set with local collective Det Gode Selskab at the Oslo, Norway leg of the Burn Energy Tour 2026.
Burn Energy is empowering an underground collective at each thrilling stop of the Burn Energy Tour 2026 to throw their dream, no-holds-barred, event, pairing internationally-renowned headliners with a line-up of emerging talent, curated by the collective. 
Like this? Subscribe: https://bit.ly/subscribemixmag

About Dr Banana:
Dr Banana is a UK DJ, record collector and label boss at the forefront of the modern UK garage revival. Founded around a love of rare records and underground club culture, Dr Banana Records has become a respected name in UKG, championing forgotten gems, reissues and new talent. From underground parties to major clubs and festivals, Dr Banana has played Fabric, Glastonbury, Panorama Bar, Hoppetosse, Waterworks and Gottwood, taking his eclectic vinyl sets around the world. His selections move effortlessly through UK garage, house, electro, techno, jungle, disco, R&B and beyond. In 2023, Dr Banana featured on the Resident Advisor RA Podcast, showcasing the deep record knowledge and unpredictable selections that have made him a standout DJ and selector. Following on from two, fiery editions of the Burn Energy Tour in 2024 and 2025, the third iteration sees us expand across Europe and Morocco, touching down in seven cities and visiting some of the world's hottest underground music scenes.

About The Burn Energy Tour:
Some of the names  involved in the Burn Energy Tour 2026 so far include Shanti Celeste, Dr Banana, Mozey, MCR-T, TSHA and Nico Moreno. This year's edition will put even more of a focus on the hardworking collectives powering some of the world's hottest underground music scenes, including ECHO7000 (Marrakech, Morocco), Šaknys (Vilnius, Lithuania), Det Gode Selskab (Oslo, Norway), Antídoto (Madrid, Spain), CRIME (Budapest, Hungary), SAFE&SOUND (Bucharest, Romania) and EXIST (Warsaw, Poland). Burn Energy will empower an underground collective at each thrilling stop of the Burn Energy Tour 2026 to throw their dream, no-holds-barred, event, which will pair up internationally-renowned headliners and a line-up of emerging talent, curated by the collective. The Burn Energy Tour 2026 has brought back the Burn Energy DJ Open, which has given seven burgeoning DJs the opportunity to perform alongside our international headliners at their nearest tour stop, each will be given a fee, travel, accommodation, a career workshop with Mixmag, and  ongoing support from Burn Energy in your next steps.
